verdicts.reason: Both drop the praying-hands photo, which is the whole visual point of the original. What is left is a faint white-on-white cloud outline and the plus marks floating in the empty left half, with the quote pushed to the right, so the design no longer reads as the same piece. A is slightly worse: a stray grey photo sliver shows at the top centre, the headline is pressed against the top edge, and 'MAHATMA GANDHI' is jammed near the bottom. B has more even vertical margins around the text block, though its plus marks are turned sideways and its left half is just as dead.
